name: The Creek’s Water
description: Restorative Power.A creature submerged in the waters for one minute receives the effects from the lesser restoration spell. Aberration Ward.Aberrations that enter the water or start their turn in it suffer 4d6 radiant damage. Golden Potions. Potions crafted using water from the spring never spoil and can’t be cursed or poisoned. Aberrations drinking them take 4d6 radiant damage. Improved Potions.Depending on the alchemist’s expertise and the type of potion, one of the following additional benefits may also apply: Healing Boost: Healing potions restore an additional 5 hit points. Extended Efficacy: The potion’s duration is increased by 50%. Restorative Effect: The potion also grants the effects of the lesser restoration spell, in addition to its standard properties
